market_summary: Singapore's Straits Times Index benefited from the Fed's September 16 rate hike, with the STI up 0.5% on the day while Wall Street retreated. Singapore banks (DBS, OCBC, UOB) drove the STI's 24.6% year-to-date gain, up dramatically from compressed margins in a rate-cutting environment. Institutional investors showed strong interest in Singapore equities, with Keppel and Thai Beverage reversing prior outflows in Q3 2026. SGX Group reported record FY2026 trading activity with securities turnover up 35% and derivatives volumes up 15% year-on-year. The US tech sector continues navigating AI spending concerns, though recent earnings from Microsoft, Amazon, and Alphabet showed mixed results relative to market expectations.

items.headline: Jefferies initiates Singapore banks coverage with Buy ratings on DBS and UOB, Hold on OCBC
items.summary: Jefferies cited further scope for earnings and dividends to compound in Singapore banks, with all three trading at premium valuations backed by proven resilience and superior capital generation.

items.headline: Fed raises rates by 25bp to 3.75%-4.00% range; Singapore banks benefit as STI outperforms
items.summary: The Fed's first rate hike since 2023 expanded Singapore bank margins. DBS, OCBC and UOB together make up 40-54% of the STI, which rose 0.5% while Wall Street retreated, as banks benefit from higher rates.

items.headline: Institutional inflows accelerate in Q3 2026; Keppel and Thai Beverage reverse outflows
items.summary: Keppel recorded S$159.2 million of net institutional inflows in Q3, reversing a S$35.7 million first-half outflow. Thai Beverage reversed more than 90% of its first-half institutional outflow with S$32.15 million in inflows.

items.headline: SGX Group reports record FY2026 trading volumes and revenue growth
items.summary: SGX derivatives volumes rose 15% year-on-year to 363.5 million contracts, while securities turnover climbed 35% to S$455.7 billion, achieving the highest securities daily average value in 18 years.

items.headline: Analysts raise Singapore Exchange price target to SGD24.15 from SGD22.33
items.summary: Price target increase reflects updated fair value estimate, discount rate, revenue growth outlook, profit margin assumptions and future P/E expectations for the exchange operator.
